content: Scaffolding shape: one shared Helm library/app chart (all T3 apps are shape-identical: Deployment+Service+Ingress+Certificate+env) + per-app values.yaml, wired via ArgoCD app-of-apps or ApplicationSet git generator scanning apps/ dir. Kustomize base+overlay duplicates more per app; custom CLI generator only needed to emit values.yaml + Dockerfile + workflow into app repos, not to template k8s YAML.
